notes: Lending a Hand = 28 parts, confirmed by PowerPyx, the Red Dead Wiki and Pixel Twelve. Pouring Forth Oil II and American Fathers are NOT included. All 28 are in the route before their cut-offs.

Home Improvement for Beginners replay workaround: reported working on patch 1.02/1.03 (PowerPyx, wiki). Search summaries of the PSNProfiles thread and a TrueAchievements comment report it still working in 2022-2025, with one Dec 2025 report that it failed. Those pages were blocked, so this is unverified. Status on the current patch is unclear. Keep it as a last resort only, as the route already does (09-cleanup).

Chapter cut-offs: Ch2 ends with A Strange Kindness, Ch3 with The Battle of Shady Belle, Ch4 with Banking. The route's earlier cut-offs (The Sheep and the Goats; Blessed are the Peacemakers / Blood Feuds) are conservative and safe. In Ch6, Of Men and Angels (and in practice the Rains Fall chain) end at The Fine Art of Conversation. Sadie ends at My Last Boy, and the other Ch6 strands end with the chapter.

verdicts.claim: Honor level 4 of 8 needed by Chapter 6 or an honor mission (Do Not Seek Absolution) will not start
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: Do Not Seek Absolution needs Honor level 4/8 (halfway to the white side). Pixel Twelve agrees on level 4. The wiki says the mission is unavailable at low Honor. The wiki also says DNSA I can be played in Chapter 5 (after A Fork in the Road) as well as Chapter 6.

verdicts.claim: Four missable trophies: LAH (Ch2/3/4/6 honor missions, each set lost when its chapter ends), FWB (one activity per Ch2/3/4 camp), Give to the Poor ($250 before Ch4 ends), Errand Boy (5 requests before Ch4 ends)
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx lists exactly these 4 missables. The wiki table has all three camp trophies available from Eastward Bound until Banking, the Old American Art. Small caveat: two Chapter 6 honor missions end before the chapter does (Of Men and Angels at The Fine Art of Conversation, Sadie Adler Widow before My Last Boy).
verdicts.fix: Optional wording: 'Each set is lost by the end of its chapter, and some Chapter 6 missions end earlier (see the Chapter 6 steps).'

verdicts.evidence: Not trophy-related. Not checked. PowerPyx tells a commenter that nothing is missable in Chapter 1 (trophy-wise), which fits the route.

verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx confirms in its comments that nothing is missable in Chapter 1. The wiki says the camp trophies become available after Eastward Bound.

verdicts.claim: Donate $250 total (cumulative, own donations only) before finishing Banking, the Old American Art
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: the tithing box exists only in Chapters 2-4. The $250 is cumulative, only your own donations count, and valuables count. Wiki table: available until Banking. Pixel Twelve: the box disappears after Chapter 4, and item donations count at their cash value.

verdicts.claim: One companion activity in the Ch2 camp (Charles hunt / Javier robbery) before The Sheep and the Goats; table games may not count
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx and the wiki list Charles (bison hunt) and Javier (home robbery) for Chapter 2, and both say these can carry into Chapter 3. PowerPyx says table games do not count. The wiki lists them as activities, so avoiding them is the safe choice. The deadline is conservative because the Chapter 2 camp lasts until A Strange Kindness.

verdicts.claim: 5 item requests total across Ch2-4; Chapter-2-only requests (Abigail $5, Jack, Javier, Mary-Beth pen, Sean bourbon, Pearson rabbit)
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx and the wiki both mark Abigail, Javier, Mary-Beth and Jack (thimble) as Chapter 2 only. Wiki: players have only triggered the Pearson rabbit request in Chapter 2. PowerPyx lists Sean's bourbon under Chapter 2, and the wiki gives Chapters 2 and 3. Both say requests happen 08:00-20:00. The wiki lists Uncle and Charles requests in Epilogue 2, but its own missable table ends Errand Boy at Banking. The Chapter 4 hard deadline is right.
verdicts.fix: Minor: call Jack's book a 'Penny Dreadful' (not 'comic book') to match both sources.

verdicts.claim: ML I & II required; before The Sheep and the Goats
verdicts.evidence: PowerPyx: all three Chapter 2 debt collections are needed, and only part III appears in the log. Wiki: I & II are not honor missions themselves but unlock the later ones, and they expire with Chapter 2. The route has them before the cut-off.

verdicts.claim: ML III required; before The Sheep and the Goats

verdicts.claim: Pouring Forth Oil II counts for Lending a Hand

The wiki Lending a Hand list leaves it out, and the 28-part total only works without it. The wiki missable page adds an important detail: Pouring Forth Oil II is skipped if left active for about 4 in-game hours.
verdicts.fix: Remove 'trophy-lending-a-hand' from counts. Change the unverified note to: 'Not an honor mission, so it doesn't count for Lending a Hand (PowerPyx, Red Dead Wiki). It is missable for 100%/gold medals.' Add to how: 'Start it as soon as John's icon appears. The wiki says it is skipped if left active for about 4 in-game hours.'

verdicts.claim: All Ch6 honor missions except Sadie Adler Widow before Fine Art; Sadie "only appears later"
verdicts.evidence: Putting everything except Sadie before Fine Art is correct and safe. The claim that Sadie only appears later is slightly off. The wiki says Sadie unlocks after Favored Sons and The Delights of Van Horn (plus The Bridge to Nowhere, depending on order). GamerGuides says after Goodbye, Dear Friend, with no more than one other open mission. RDR2.org's mission order has Goodbye, Dear Friend, Sadie and Favored Sons before Archeology and Fine Art. Sadie is not tied to Fine Art, so it can come before or after it.
verdicts.fix: Change the Sadie bullet to: 'Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow is not tied to this mission. It unlocks after Goodbye, Dear Friend / Favored Sons and is lost when My Last Boy starts, so it is covered after this mission.' Optional belt-and-braces reorder that also satisfies the Codeberg checklist: move Goodbye, Dear Friend (162), Favored Sons (163) and both Sadie steps (164-165) before Archeology for Beginners (156). The wiki and RDR2.org both allow that order.

verdicts.claim: Sadie Widow I unlocks only after Fine Art/Favored Sons; deadline end of Chapter 6
verdicts.evidence: The placement after Favored Sons is valid, and Codeberg's claim that it is lost at Fine Art is false. The wiki shows it unlocks from Favored Sons + The Delights of Van Horn (+ The Bridge to Nowhere), and The King's Son needs Fine Art + Favored Sons, so Sadie can come after Fine Art. Two things are wrong. (1) The deadline is too loose: the wiki has My Last Boy as Sadie's next mission and lists Sadie as a My Last Boy prerequisite, so it is gone once My Last Boy starts, not at the end of the chapter. (2) The route never says you must ACCEPT: the wiki says declining Sadie's request in part I lowers Honor and blocks part II, which loses Lending a Hand.
verdicts.fix: Set deadline to "before starting 'My Last Boy'" (deadlineMissionId mission-my-last-boy). Add to how: 'When Sadie asks for help, ACCEPT. Declining lowers Honor and part II never appears, which loses Lending a Hand.' Change the unlock note to: 'Unlocks after Favored Sons and The Delights of Van Horn (and The Bridge to Nowhere if you did Van Horn before Favored Sons). GamerGuides adds that you may need to have no more than one other mission open.'
